newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Aug 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Aug 14.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page Thursday.

* The Senate committee investigating campaign finance has issued 26 subpoenas to nonprofit advocacy groups on both the right and left seeking documents including correspondences with candidates and confidential strategy memos.
* United Parcel Service officials said the Teamsters union is opposing a UPS proposal for a new pension plan that would increase monthly pension benefits an average 50 percent.
* The bitter cultural conflict over continued financing of the National Endowment for the Arts is starting to spread to towns and cities across the U.S.
* Indians, filled with pride as the country nears its 50th anniversary, are less sanguine about widespread poverty in their nation and rising criminality within the new political class.
